client.business_model: Multi-state women's health platform operating OB/GYN and related specialty clinics, supported by telehealth and technology-enabled services.
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has expanded through acquisitions such as Heartland Women’s Healthcare (2019) and now operates clinics across the Mid-Atlantic, Illinois and Missouri. The company focuses on integrated, technology-enabled care for women and has raised growth capital from Deerfield Management (2016) and BlueMountain Capital Management (2020) to accelerate expansion.

revenue.notes: Revenue estimates vary widely: Zippia $13.0M, Buzzfile $29.1M, Growjo $22.4M, CanvasBusinessModel $89M. No official figures disclosed; using mid-range Growjo estimate and flagging low confidence.

locations.source: Advantia Health locations page (advantiahealth.com/locations) cross-referenced with 2019 Heartland acquisition press release (PR Newswire 02-05-2019)
locations.notes: Press release states Heartland added 25 locations; the current website lists additional Mid-Atlantic clinics bringing total to roughly 40. Exact count not explicitly published.

employees.source: Zippia employee count (750, zippia.com) corroborated by Indeed and SignalHire ranges (501-1,000)
employees.notes: Multiple sources cluster between 500 and 1,000 employees. Zippia provides specific figure of 750, consistent with range from other sources.
